full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media wildlife portrait sets a white stag's head and sweeping antlers against a saturated red field. The animal faces forward from the lower center, its pale muzzle and dark nose forming the firmest shapes near the middle. Fine gray marks describe the fur around the cheeks, neck and ears, while the eyes remain small, dark and calm. Its antlers branch widely toward both upper corners, almost touching the edges, and their smooth pale curves stand out cleanly from the flat red ground. Two tiny white bird forms appear high among the left and right antler branches, adding delicate movement to the otherwise frontal stillness. The lower neck breaks into long, narrow drips that descend through the red, so the carefully drawn animal seems to dissolve into paint. No horizon, ground or other setting interrupts the broad background. Subtle shadowing in cool gray gives the face and antlers volume, but there is no modeled space behind them. Illumination is even and frontal, brightest on the upper antler surfaces and face, with soft gray recesses inside the ears and under the muzzle. The texture shifts sharply between hairlike pencil detail, smooth antler shading, flat opaque red color and fluid vertical streaks. The composition is strongly centered, letting wide branching curves occupy the upper half while the fading drips leave open red space below. Its overall effect is bold and contemplative, balancing naturalistic detail with graphic reduction.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介野生动物肖像把白鹿的头与展开的鹿角置于饱和红色底前。动物从下方中央正面望来，浅色口鼻和深色鼻头在画面中部构成最明确的形状。细灰笔痕刻画脸颊、颈部与耳朵周围的毛发，眼睛小而深，神情平静。鹿角向两侧上角宽阔分枝，几乎触及画边，平滑浅色曲线在平坦红底前十分清晰。两只小白鸟出现在左、右鹿角枝之间的高处，为正面静止的形象增添轻微动感。下方颈毛散成长而狭窄的滴痕，向红色区域中垂落，使细致描绘的动物仿佛溶入颜料。宽阔背景没有地平线、地面或其他场景干扰。冷灰色的细微阴影让脸与鹿角有体积，但后方没有被塑出的空间。光线均匀而正面，鹿角上缘和面部最亮，耳内及口鼻下方留柔灰凹影。肌理在发丝般铅笔细节、平滑鹿角塑形、平涂不透明红色与流动竖向滴痕之间骤变。构图强烈居中，让宽阔分枝曲线占据上半部，淡去的滴痕使下方仍有红色空地。整体效果大胆而沉思，以自然主义细节平衡图形化简化。
style_prompt_en: A graphic mixed-media treatment joins meticulous cool-gray pencil modeling to a single saturated flat color field. Fine directional lines build soft texture within pale forms, while smooth broad curves carry a clearer silhouette against the uniform ground. Selected details stay sharply naturalistic, but lower edges release into narrow vertical paint drips and partial transparency. The palette is deliberately restricted: one intense warm hue, near-white highlights, gray midtones and a few dark accents. Lighting is even and frontal, with gentle internal shadow rather than cast shadow or deep setting. A centered pale mass opens into wide upper branching rhythms, balanced by long descending streaks and generous uninterrupted color. The result is arresting, spare and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 图形化混合媒介处理把细致冷灰铅笔塑形与一整块饱和平涂色域连接。细密定向线在浅色形体内部建立柔软肌理，平滑宽曲线则在均匀底色前撑起更明确的剪影。少数细节保持锐利的自然主义描绘，下缘却散成狭窄竖向颜料滴痕与局部透明。色盘刻意受限：一种强烈暖色、近白高光、灰色中间调和少数深色重音。照明均匀而正面，以轻微内部阴影塑形，不依赖投影或深层场景。居中的浅色体量向上展开宽阔分枝节奏，再由下垂长痕与宽裕完整色面取得平衡。整体醒目、简净且有触感。
theme_en: A finely drawn white stag head with sweeping antlers against saturated red
theme_zh: 饱和红底前，一只细描白鹿的头与展开的鹿角
name: Louise McNaught
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
